2026-11-11 source-pin maintenance: registryContentHash refreshed after the JavaScript test hardening of coding-trust step 10, approved by the project owner. Five pinned source questions gain checks for behavior their text and rubric criteria already describe, and the new checks join the rubric groups that state that behavior. Deep equal: three checks (different kinds of object, the same set of keys, NaN, -0 and RegExp details); the reference solution now compares Object.prototype.toString tags, so a Date no longer equals {}, as its edge cases already said. Debounce: one check for the last call's this and all of its arguments; the summary loses its page copy. LRU cache: two checks (an update makes a key the most recent; an update at capacity evicts nothing); the returns text says that size() is a method and in which order keys() lists the keys. Concurrency map: the limit check is renamed 'rejects a limit below 1' and accepts a rejection as well as a synchronous throw, which the async starter could not meet; two checks cover refilling a slot as soon as it frees up and starting no new items after a fail-fast error, and the concurrency-bound and error-strategies groups each gain one criterion for them. Once: one check for a wrapped function that returns undefined. Question hashes are re-pinned for all five; the debounce prompt loses only the page copy, the other prompts are unchanged; time limits and revisions are unchanged. Pin maintenance under registry version 1.1.0, not a new release.

rubric.title: Input and length contract
criteria: Reject non-string inputs.
Accept only names between 3 and 16 characters.

rubric.title: Username rules
criteria: Require a lowercase letter as the first character.
Allow lowercase letters, digits, and underscores without trailing or consecutive underscores.
checkNames: rejects leading digit, trailing underscore, or consecutive underscores

rubric.title: Encoding contract
criteria: Encode ampersand, angle brackets, double quote, and apostrophe.
Leave ordinary text unchanged and avoid double-decoding existing entities.

rubric.title: Context boundary
criteria: Keep the implementation scoped to HTML text-content interpolation.
Do not present the encoder as a general sanitizer.

rubric.title: Cancellation ownership
criteria: Give each call its own AbortController.
Abort only the previous in-flight call when a newer call starts.
checkNames: does not abort a controller after its call has completed

rubric.title: Latest-call settlement
criteria: Allow only the newest call to resolve successfully.
Prevent stale cleanup from clearing ownership of a newer call.
checkNames: a stale finally cannot clear the newer in-flight controller

rubric.title: Error propagation
criteria: Preserve errors from the current call.
Expose cancellation as an AbortError-compatible rejection.
checkNames: propagates errors from the latest call

rubric.title: Response contract
criteria: Parse JSON only from successful responses.
Reject non-OK responses with the HTTP status.

rubric.title: Timeout cancellation
criteria: Abort the request when timeoutMs elapses.
Clear owned timeout resources after every terminal path.

rubric.title: External signal composition
criteria: Respect an already-aborted or later-aborted caller signal.
Do not leak abort listeners after settlement.
checkNames: the embedded fetch mock handles an already-aborted signal

rubric.title: Capacity contract
criteria: Reject non-positive or non-integer capacities.
Evict exactly the least-recently-used key on overflow.
checkNames: updating a key at capacity evicts nothing

rubric.title: Recency contract
criteria: Refresh recency on successful get.
Refresh recency without growing size when an existing key is updated.
checkNames: updating an existing key does not grow size
updating a key makes it the most recent

rubric.title: Cache API contract
criteria: Keep has, size, clear, and keys consistent with stored entries.
Return keys from least to most recently used.

rubric.title: Concurrency bound
criteria: Reject an invalid limit.
Never run more workers concurrently than the configured limit.
Start the next item as soon as a running worker finishes.
checkNames: respects concurrency limit (no more than limit active)
starts the next item as soon as a slot frees up

rubric.title: Ordered results
criteria: Write every result at its source index.
Resolve in input order despite different worker durations.

rubric.title: Error strategies
criteria: Reject the fail-fast mode on its first observed worker error.
Return ordered fulfilled and rejected outcomes in all-settled mode.
Start no new items after a fail-fast error.
checkNames: fail-fast starts no new items after an error

rubric.title: Inclusive numeric bounds
criteria: Return values already inside the range unchanged.
Clamp low and high inputs to their respective inclusive bounds.

rubric.title: Stable deduplication
criteria: Keep the first occurrence and preserve input order.
Apply one equality policy consistently to numbers, strings, mixed values, and NaN.
checkNames: works with strings and preserves first-seen order

rubric.title: Collection boundaries
criteria: Return a valid empty result for empty input.
Leave an already unique sequence semantically unchanged.

rubric.title: Single invocation ownership
criteria: Invoke the wrapped function only for the first call.
Cache and return the first result on every later call.
checkNames: returns the first result on later calls
does not call again when the first call returned undefined

rubric.title: Call context
criteria: Forward the first call's receiver to the wrapped function.

rubric.title: Trailing-edge timer ownership
criteria: Do not invoke synchronously and restart the delay for every call in a burst.
Run only the most recent call after the final delay.
checkNames: does not call synchronously and runs after delay
rapid calls only run the latest argument after the final delay

rubric.title: Invocation forwarding
criteria: Forward the latest arguments and receiver when the timer fires.
checkNames: uses the this value and all arguments of the last call

rubric.title: Subscription identity
criteria: Store independent listeners per event.
Remove only the requested listener without disturbing peers.
checkNames: calls listener when event is emitted
handles multiple listeners for same event

rubric.title: Unknown event boundary
criteria: Treat unknown events and listeners as safe no-ops.
checkNames: emit/off are no-op for unknown events/listeners

rubric.title: Key resolution and grouping
criteria: Resolve keys from either a callback or a property name.
Preserve input order within every group.

rubric.title: Empty input
criteria: Return an empty grouping for an empty array.
checkNames: returns empty object for empty array

rubric.title: Recursive structural comparison
criteria: Compare primitives by value and recurse through matching object keys.
Treat array order as significant.
checkNames: requires the same set of keys

rubric.title: Special value semantics
criteria: Compare Date and RegExp values by their semantic payload.
Distinguish null from undefined while honoring the documented NaN behavior.

rubric.title: Streaming frame reassembly
criteria: Carry incomplete lines across arbitrary chunk boundaries.
Flush a valid final line even without a trailing newline.
Normalize CRLF and skip blank records.
checkNames: parses lines across arbitrary chunk boundaries
handles last line without trailing newline
skips blank lines and trims CRLF

rubric.title: Record error isolation
criteria: Report a malformed record through onError and continue parsing later lines.
checkNames: reports malformed lines via onError and continues

rubric.title: Timeout race
criteria: Resolve when work wins and reject when the timeout wins.
Settle exactly once and clear owned timeout resources.
checkNames: withTimeout resolves when promise is fast

rubric.title: Abort boundary
criteria: Resolve normally while the signal remains active.
Reject with the abort boundary when the signal fires.

rubric.title: Signal composition
criteria: Abort the composed signal when any source aborts.
Return an already-aborted signal when any input is already aborted.
checkNames: composeAbort aborts when any source aborts
composeAbort is already aborted if any input is aborted
